manage.emptyDescription: Add a widget to get a short piece of code. Paste it into your website, and visitors can chat with your receptionist.
manage.originsHint: List every address where the chat should appear, starting with https://. Separate them with commas.
manage.createdDescription: Paste this code before the closing </body> tag on your website. You can copy it again from the widget's card.
manage.revokeDescription: The chat disappears from every website that uses this widget. You can't undo this.
